summary: Backend regression after /app/backend/.env fix (malformed `whsec_=...` line removed; `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_...` added). Backend boots clean, Stripe is still configured, all targeted endpoints + 31 prior regression tests (iter22/iter23/iter24) pass.

minor.issue: No dedicated health route exists (404). Root /api/ returns 200 and is used as liveness. Pre-existing, not a regression of this change.

critical_code_review_comments: .env hygiene confirmed: only `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` is present; the invalid bare `whsec_=...` variable name is gone. Verified via dotenv load + os.environ check.
routes/subscriptions.py:_webhook_secret() reads os.environ.get('STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET','').strip() — confirmed value loads as expected (starts with whsec_).
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded admin and pre-existing project data (34 projects on admin account).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is healthy post-.env-fix. Stripe live keys are loaded (STRIPE_API_KEY, STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET). Checkout against live Stripe successfully created a session (real Stripe URLs returned during /api/subscriptions/checkout calls — note: live keys, not test keys). If a `/api/health` endpoint is desired, main agent should add one; currently `/api/` is the implicit health check.
rca of the issue: Root cause was an invalid env-var name `whsec_` (line started with `whsec_=...`). Kubernetes/production env loaders reject names that violate POSIX env-name rules or duplicate the value prefix. Fix: removed the malformed line and added properly-named `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET=whsec_UE3VihQI301N7QdWEtCgIwOtbxeyywvl`. Backend now boots cleanly, no restart loop, and signature verification path in subscriptions._webhook_secret() reads the value correctly.
